chapters.title: A Hub for your EU-HEM journey
chapters.summary: Find the information, study spaces and practical tools that help you move through the programme.
highlights: See your week at a glance
Search from any page
Choose your theme and install the app
chapters.note: The Hub is an unofficial volunteer project. Offline copies may be older than their original sources.

chapters.title: From your courses to your next exam
chapters.summary: Build your personal study plan, find published classes and exam dates, and keep programme milestones nearby.
highlights: Choose courses within the published plan rules
Explore classes, rooms and exam sittings
Follow key dates and subscribe to a calendar
chapters.note: Saving a plan does not submit it. Adding an exam to your calendar does not register you for it.

chapters.title: Read, experiment and practise
chapters.summary: Move from the study library into course guides, interactive lessons and dedicated practice spaces.
highlights: Find topics, concepts and source-linked resources
Use flashcards, quizzes and worked exercises
Review your locally saved learning progress
chapters.note: Content coverage varies by course. Student-made guides and practice support learning; official materials and assessment instructions remain on university platforms.

chapters.title: Turn a question into a next step
chapters.summary: Find useful services, work through academic problems and organise your own study, moving and career plans.
highlights: Save tools, build lists and compare options
Explore methods, Excel recipes and health-economics calculations
Use practical planners with local exports
chapters.note: Workbench drafts stay in the current tab until you choose to save them on this device. Calculations depend on your inputs and each tool's stated assumptions.

chapters.title: Connect your interests with what comes next
chapters.summary: Compare specialisations and partner universities, develop research ideas and learn from historical thesis topics.
highlights: Compare track routes, courses and elective rules
Explore research themes and past thesis titles
Build a private research plan and export a brief
chapters.note: Historical thesis titles and student-made classifications are inspiration. Confirm current supervision, ethics, submission and assessment requirements with your university.

chapters.title: Prepare, arrive and feel at home
chapters.summary: Explore everyday student life, prepare for your next move and find the right university support.
highlights: Follow your programme route
Explore city-specific guidance and sources
Connect preparation checklists with practical tools
chapters.note: Guides and checklists help you prepare. Confirm residence, insurance, grants and other personal requirements with the relevant official service.

chapters.title: Discover the community around EU-HEM
chapters.summary: Explore the cohort overview, read student and alumni perspectives, and follow updates from the Hub.
highlights: Explore the supplied cohort origins overview
Browse stories and contribute your experience
Follow announcements and future community spaces
chapters.note: Individual directory profiles are fictional demos. Events and Gallery are previews; contributed experiences require separate review and author approval before publication.

chapters.title: See the work and help shape the Hub
chapters.summary: Understand how the Hub is built, follow its development and find the current contact and privacy information.
highlights: Distinguish released features from future plans
Explore the effort behind the project
Send corrections, questions and ideas
chapters.note: Roadmap targets are estimates. Personal saved choices belong to their browser and web address; accounts and cross-device sync are not available.

routes.label: I'm studying here
routes.intro: Start with your semester and your next study session.

routes.label: I'm exploring EU-HEM
routes.intro: Get a feel for the specialisations, places and student perspectives.

routes.label: I want the programme overview
routes.intro: Understand the journey, academic rules and where to ask questions.

extras.title: Statistics Study Centre
extras.description: Review Statistics for Healthcare with spaced practice, mixed quizzes, worked calculations and interpretation exercises.

extras.title: Fundamentals of Statistics
extras.description: Explore the separate Fundamentals workspace: original guides, guided experiments, worked cases, lab readers and practice.

extras.title: Statistics Lab
extras.description: Explore probability, data summaries, intervals and tests with assumptions, visual explanations and worked steps.

extras.title: FHEM Exam Centre
extras.description: Practise Fundamentals in Health Economics with student-made exercises and an illustrative timed mixed mock.

extras.title: Right to Health study workspace
extras.description: Read original guides, explore source-linked cases and practise with questions, cards and written-answer scaffolds.

extras.title: Course workspace example
extras.description: Explore a course's overview, published schedule, exam information, syllabus and source links. Study-content depth varies by course.

extras.title: Interactive lecture example
extras.description: Explore sampling through an original study guide, interactive activities and quiz practice.

extras.title: Create study content
extras.description: Prepare flashcards, questions, concepts or resources as text to copy. This form does not send, save or publish an entry.

extras.title: Economics graphs
extras.description: Explore a hypothetical supply-and-demand market, shifts, surplus and elasticity; export results.

extras.title: Sample precision planner
extras.description: Estimate observations for mean or proportion confidence-interval precision, with assumptions and recruitment-loss allowance.

extras.title: Study session planner
extras.description: Turn tasks, capacity and your target date into a personal session plan with explicit unscheduled work and calendar export.

extras.title: City budget scenarios
extras.description: Compare your own city budgets, deposits and cash needs using entered amounts and exchange-rate assumptions.

extras.title: Moving checklist
extras.description: Organise personal preparation, arrival and settling tasks with optional dates and custom entries.

extras.title: Document dates
extras.description: Track labels and dates you enter and export calendar reminders. The Hub sends no background notifications.

extras.title: Career application tracker
extras.description: Organise opportunities, follow-ups and preparation checks. No CV upload or application submission.

extras.title: Statistical Test Finder
extras.description: Work through a study-design question to find a method and its assumptions; follow links for further learning.

extras.title: Excel Formula Assistant
extras.description: Explore original formula recipes with input guidance, worked checks and spreadsheet conventions.

extras.title: Health-economics calculators
extras.description: Explore cost-effectiveness comparisons, QALYs and discounting with transparent inputs and educational limits.

extras.title: Thesis research roadmap
extras.description: Follow a student-made research workflow and identify what to confirm with your university and supervisor.

extras.title: Thesis topic ideas
extras.description: Explore illustrative research questions and themes as starting points, rather than approved projects.

extras.title: Thesis methods and writing toolkit
extras.description: Find method prompts, research checklists, writing guidance and source-linked support.

extras.title: Personal thesis planner
extras.description: Develop a local research draft and checklist, then download a backup or research brief.

extras.title: Historical thesis archive
extras.description: Search titles from earlier cohorts, with legacy tracks and clearly labelled title-based Hub classifications.
